**Promptly Core Features:**

• **Smart Comment Generator:** Create personalized feedback in seconds
• **Parent Email Assistant:** Draft professional, warm communications
• **Multi-language Support:** Translate to 12+ languages instantly
• **Report Writing Tools:** Streamline progress reports and assessments
• **Tone Adjustment:** Choose warm, professional, or supportive voice
• **Privacy-First:** No student data stored, FERPA/GDPR compliant

**Integration & Export:**

• Export to DOC/PDF for easy sharing
• Works with Google Classroom, Canvas, Schoology
• CSV import/export for gradebooks
• Batch processing for multiple students
• Offline templates for backup

**AI Teaching Assistant (Zara):**

• Get practical classroom management advice
• Ask about differentiation strategies
• Help with lesson planning and assessment
• Parent communication templates
• Evidence-based teaching strategies
